errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network: Could not reach Lynx. Check that the bot is running.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.csrf: The request was refused. Reload the page.
errors.unauthorized: Your session ended. Sign in again.

off.title: The admin panel is not available
off.body: Lynx is not running, or the admin panel is turned off. Set ADMIN_PASSWORD (at least 12 characters) in the environment and restart Lynx.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Operator panel for this Lynx instance.

overview.maintenanceOn: Maintenance mode is on: new songs are refused.

notices.intro: Notices appear in every Discord reply of the bot and as a banner in the Activity, in each user's own time zone. The soonest visible notice is shown.
notices.title: Title
notices.messageHint: What users should know. Plain text, no formatting.
notices.showFromHint: When users start seeing it. Empty: right away.
notices.activeHint: Inactive notices are kept but never shown.
notices.timezone: Times are in your local time zone ({{zone}}) and stored in UTC.
notices.invalidStart: Pick a start date and time.
notices.invalidEnd: Pick an end after the start.

tweaks.intro: Runtime switches. They apply at once, without a restart, and are kept across restarts.
tweaks.maintenanceHint: Refuses new songs (/play, /ai, adding from the panel) with the current notice. Music that is already playing keeps going.
tweaks.pauseYtdlpHint: Skips the daily automatic update. A manual check below still works.

outcome.failed: The update check failed (see the logs).

tweaks.clearStreamHint: Forgets the resolved audio URLs kept in memory; the next songs resolve again.
tweaks.clearLookupHint: Empties the saved searches, playlist pages and YouTube matches; they are fetched again when needed.
tweaks.confirmLookup: Clear the lookup cache? Searches and lists will be slower for a while.
